items.headline: Community thread discusses rollback netcode for Brood War
items.summary: A new thread on TL.net's Brood War forum is about rollback netcode in Brood War. Rollback is a networking method that keeps online games responsive by predicting inputs and correcting them when they arrive. See the thread for the details and the community discussion.
items.card: TL.net thread on bringing rollback netcode to Brood War
